title: Machine Learning Methodology Annex — Applies to MS0, MS1, MS4, MS7
authority: RGS Stage 10 scrutiny ML reviewer finding (58 score) — required to reach >= 70
scope: Any unit involving training, inference, embedding, retrieval, or RL within CADCAM-DAGI milestones

data_splits.strategy: TEMPORAL SPLIT — not random. CAD/CAM evolves; random split leaks future into past.
data_splits.implementation: Sort JM Die corpus by original file modification date. First 70% = train, next 15% = val, last 15% = test.
data_splits.cross_validation: 5-fold time-series CV for hyperparameter search. Only fit hyperparameters on train+val, never touch test until final evaluation.
data_splits.leak_prevention: RAG retrieval index built only from train split. Test programs never seen by retriever during evaluation.

embedding_MS1_U-DASAL03_U-DASAL07_U-DASA.ablation_required: Test embedding dim in [64, 128, 256, 512]; pick min that reaches 95% of 512-dim performance

pretraining_strategy_MS0.issue: Corpus 24,545 parts x ~250 tokens ≈ 6M tokens is insufficient for from-scratch transformer. DeepCAD / SkexGen use 100M-1B.
pretraining_strategy_MS0.solution: Initialize from pretrained code LLM (CodeT5-large or StarCoder-1B), then fine-tune with LoRA adapters on CAD token corpus.
pretraining_strategy_MS0.fine_tune_epochs: Up to 20 with early stopping on val loss
pretraining_strategy_MS0.base_model_license: Must verify CodeT5/StarCoder license compatible with PRISM commercial use

rl_policy_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI02.algorithm: PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) with clipped surrogate objective
rl_policy_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI02.rationale: On-policy, sample-efficient, stable for continuous+discrete action spaces, well-suited to moment-state with ~30 variables
rl_policy_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI02.reward_function: r_t = w_time * (-cycle_time_delta) + w_tool * (tool_life_delta) + w_quality * (1[surface_in_tol]) + w_safety * (-10 * 1[S(x)<0.70]) + w_cost * (-cost_delta). Weights chosen via shop-operator survey (tuned via inverse RL from JM Die human choices).
rl_policy_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI02.exploration: Gaussian noise with schedule sigma=0.3 → 0.05 over 100k steps
rl_policy_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI02.safety_constraint: CPO (Constrained Policy Optimization) variant to enforce S(x) >= 0.70 during training as hard constraint, not just reward penalty
rl_policy_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI02.simulation_env: Must use VariabilityAdaptiveOrchestrator as simulator — never train on live machines until policy converges in sim

kalman_filter_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI.state_transition_F: Linear time-invariant per segment; derived from machine dynamics model (decoupled mass-spring per axis) — for nonlinear transitions upgrade to Extended Kalman (EKF) or Unscented (UKF)
kalman_filter_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI.observation_H: Sensor selection matrix — maps state to observable (spindle current → spindle_load via torque constant; acceleration → feed_force via F=ma)
kalman_filter_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI.process_noise_Q: Diagonal, tuned via residual whiteness (Wald test on autocorrelation of innovations). Initial values: diag([0.1, 0.1, 5.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 0.001, 0.5, 0.01])
kalman_filter_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI.measurement_noise_R: Diagonal, per-sensor catalog (spindle current: 2% of reading; accelerometer: 0.5 m/s^2; thermocouple: 1 deg C)
kalman_filter_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI.nonlinearity_handling: Upgrade to UKF if Jacobian condition number > 100 during operation. Sigma points via Merwe scaled (alpha=1e-3, beta=2, kappa=0)
kalman_filter_specification_MS4_U-CAMAGI.divergence_monitor: If normalized innovation squared (NIS) exceeds chi-squared(dim_z, 0.99) for > 5 consecutive steps, filter has diverged — reinitialize from geometric prior

benchmark_statistics_MS7_U-DAE2E06.sample_size: Minimum n = 385 programs for 95% CI with 5% margin of error. Sample via stratified random sampling on (material_family, operation_type, machine_class) to avoid bias.
benchmark_statistics_MS7_U-DAE2E06.supplementary: Paired McNemar test per (AGI, human) pair on same part. Wilson score interval for rate estimation (better than Wald for extreme rates).
benchmark_statistics_MS7_U-DAE2E06.multiple_comparison: If per-stratum breakdown reported, Bonferroni correction on family-wise error rate
benchmark_statistics_MS7_U-DAE2E06.win_condition: AGI wins iff (cycle_time <= 1.05 * human) AND (surface_finish_in_tol) AND (tool_life >= 0.9 * human) AND (S(x) >= 0.70 throughout)

cad_evaluation_metrics_MS0_MS3.validity_rate: % of generated models that pass MS3 BRepTopologyValidator (watertight 2-manifold)
cad_evaluation_metrics_MS0_MS3.chamfer_L2: Symmetric Chamfer distance between generated and reference surface samples (N=10,000 points). Target: < 0.05 mm RMS
cad_evaluation_metrics_MS0_MS3.feature_F1: F1 score on feature recovery (holes, pockets, bosses, ribs). Target: >= 0.90
cad_evaluation_metrics_MS0_MS3.parametric_consistency_score: Fraction of parameters in generated model that satisfy ground-truth constraints. Target: >= 0.95
cad_evaluation_metrics_MS0_MS3.rebuild_robustness: Fraction of models that rebuild without errors after random parameter perturbation ±10%. Target: >= 0.95
cad_evaluation_metrics_MS0_MS3.dimensional_fidelity: Mean absolute error of critical dimensions vs spec. Target: < 0.01 mm
cad_evaluation_metrics_MS0_MS3.intent_preservation: Fraction of parallel/perpendicular/tangent relations preserved after generation. Target: >= 0.95

compute_budget.training_MS0: Estimated 4x A100 80GB for 72h for LoRA fine-tune. Checkpoint every 6h.
compute_budget.inference_MS0: Single A100 can serve ~10 req/sec. Target p99 latency 2s for 250-token generation.
compute_budget.rl_training_MS4: 8x A100 80GB for 1 week with simulated environment. ~100M steps total.
compute_budget.benchmark_MS7: 100 parallel CPU workers, 4GB RAM each, 30s timeout per program. Full 24,545 corpus runs in ~2 hours (well under 24-hour budget).

reproducibility_requirements.seeds: All random seeds explicitly set in training scripts (numpy, torch, cuda). Document seed in config.
reproducibility_requirements.versioning: Dataset version hash, model checkpoint hash, code commit SHA all logged for every training run.
reproducibility_requirements.artifacts: Store in data/state/ml-experiments/ with schema: {run_id, timestamp, config, metrics, checkpoint_path, git_sha}

re_scrutiny_trigger: After this annex is committed and referenced from MS0/MS1/MS4/MS7, invoke ml-developer agent again to re-score. Target: >= 75.
